subject: CAIQ control routing & evidence stewarding — CloudBridge onboarding
messages:
From: Laura Marino <laura@cloudbridge.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@cloudbridge.com
Date: 2028-01-09T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: CAIQ: Evidence routing & custodian list for Redwood onboarding

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the kickoff earlier. As part of CloudBridge's procurement checklist we need a CAIQ (CSA CCM) control-to-artifact mapping and a named custodian for each control group so our security team can verify during the assessment window. Specifically we need:

- A simple matrix (CSV or Excel) that lists control IDs, short descriptions, Redwood assertions, artifact filenames, and the internal owner responsible for producing/logging the evidence.
- A short statement on retention and access (where logs/snapshots will be stored and for how long).
- Any known gaps or compensating controls.

Could you (or the right owners) drop an initial index by EOD PT Tuesday? We're trying to lock the audit window the week of Jan 22nd.

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Laura Marino
Security Programs Manager
CloudBridge

[Attachment: requested_template.csv (spreadsheet stub)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Marino <laura@cloudbridge.com>, security@cloudbridge.com
Date: 2028-01-09T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: Evidence routing & custodian list for Redwood onboarding

Laura — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Kimberly (controls owner) and Marissa (evidence ops) to own the first pass.

Proposed plan:
1) Kimberly to map CSA CCM controls -> Redwood assertions and assign a custodian for each control family.
2) Marissa to collate artifacts into a Drive folder and provide a compact index (CSV + short narrative for retention/access).
3) We will flag any gaps and propose compensating controls or short remediation timelines.

I've attached a starter index (initial_caiq_index.csv) and created a shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bC_example_caiq_index

Kimberly / Marissa — can you produce the first-draft CSV and a snapshot of current artifacts by EOD Tuesday PT (Jan 10)? If any items need legal, infra, or engineering signoff, call them out in the row 'action_required'.

Thanks — 
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: initial_caiq_index.csv (spreadsheet)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Marino <laura@cloudbridge.com>, security@cloudbridge.com
Date: 2028-01-09T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: Evidence routing & custodian list for Redwood onboarding

On Tue, Jan 9, 2028 at 11:04 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Kimberly / Marissa — can you produce the first-draft CSV and a snapshot of current artifacts by EOD Tuesday PT (Jan 10)?

Thanks Vanessa — assigning owners and dropping a short mapping below (first pass). I'll upload the full CCM artifact matrix (ccm_artifact_matrix_v1.xlsx) to the Drive folder and link the rows to file names.

Sample rows (control id ; short desc ; assigned owner ; artifact file name ; action_required):
- IAM-01 ; Identity lifecycle (provision/deprovision) ; Marissa Cole ; iam_provisioning_playbook.pdf ; none
- LOG-03 ; Retention & centralized logging ; Marcus Lin ; logging_architecture_diagram.pdf ; confirm retention windows (eng)
- NET-02 ; Network segmentation ; Karthik Iyer ; vpc_design_diagram.png ; none
- ACC-07 ; Access review cadence ; Kimberly Park ; quarterly_access_review.xlsx ; confirm last review date

Retention summary (short): logs stored in our GCS audit bucket (projects/redwood-logs), 365-day hot retention, 5-year cold archive for access logs; access via RBAC to audit-team and custodians. Full retention and access control narrative is in the Drive 'Retention_and_Access.md' file.

I'll upload ccm_artifact_matrix_v1.xlsx now and will flag any controls where we only have partial coverage. Ticketing follow-up: I've linked gaps to SEC-472 in Jira so we have traceability.

Kimberly Park
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: ccm_artifact_matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Laura Marino <laura@cloudbridge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-01-10T15:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: Evidence routing & custodian list for Redwood onboarding

Kimberly/Vanessa/Marissa —

Received the index and matrix — thank you, that is very helpful. A couple quick asks before we lock the audit window:

- Can we get the highlighted 'partial coverage' rows expanded with a short note on the expected remediation timeline (or compensating control) by EOD Friday?
- Please confirm the retention bucket path and that CloudBridge will be granted auditor read access (we can send the AWS/GCP role details once you confirm the path).
- Can we schedule a 60-minute walkthrough the week of Jan 22nd; preference Wed/Thu morning PT.

If you can confirm the timeline and ownership, we'll move forward with scheduling.

Thanks again —
Laura Marino
Security Programs Manager
CloudBridge
